title: Browser-verify V18 Notas/fecha and login capability honesty
mission: Verify the completed V18 Notas/fecha bridge and generic login capability boundary in a representative JavaScript desktop and narrow/mobile browser. Confirm only real legacy session/date rows or honest empty/error states render, the login control remains visibly disabled/capability-honest, Version anterior remains usable, and no runtime errors occur. Do not infer Human Accepted or promote Current/Served.
definition_of_done: Notas/fecha renders real legacy session/date rows when present, or honest loading/error/empty states, with no synthetic Clase 01-04 or Fecha por definir placeholders.
The generic login control is visibly disabled/capability-honest and does not behave as a fake or Blackboard-aliased product login.
Desktop and narrow/mobile representative JavaScript views complete without runtime errors.
Version anterior remains usable from the same surface.
Concrete browser/runtime evidence is recorded; no Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion is inferred.
